problem.text: The change attempts to improve Markdown scrollback by reducing the redraw height and taking it from the terminal rather than Rich's console dimensions.

reasoning.text: Using terminal rows minus two leaves a two-row margin for redraws. This plausibly avoids rewinding into inaccessible scrollback, but the precise reason for choosing two rows is not documented.

impact.text: The change affects Markdown answer display through Streamer_rich; basic streaming, full Markdown rendering and accumulated answer text are unchanged.

source_notes.text: The preceding redraw entry describes the existing height-bounded suffix algorithm and records reasoning-boundary answer loss.

Issue #7, “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate,” reports extension loading failure; issue #15, “`cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B` generates incoherent output for bpw <= 2.5,” reports quantization quality problems. Neither provides terminal-redraw evidence.

limitations: No interactive terminal or Rich execution was performed; successful scrollback correction remains unverified.
Dimensions remain a construction-time snapshot, so terminal resizing is not accommodated by update.
The scalar check covers positive redraw heights only and does not model terminal cursor behavior.

chapters.title: Reserve terminal rows when redrawing Markdown

claims.text: MarkdownConsoleStream now stores height = r - 2 from shutil.get_terminal_size(fallback=(80, 24)), rather than unpacking self.console.size. The fallback therefore gives a 22-row redraw budget. The separate two-column reduction for emoji overflow remains unchanged, and the unused self.width assignment disappears.

update still renders the entire answer and computes prefix = max(common_prefix, old_count - height, new_count - height). Cursor movement, clearing and printing use the resulting suffixes; the complete new line list is retained. Even a supplied Console now uses the separately queried terminal row budget.

A scalar transcription checked 357,216 combinations for the suffix-height bound. With 30 old lines, 31 new lines and no common prefix, changing height from 24 to 22 changes the preserved prefix from 7 to 9 and the old/new suffix lengths from 23/24 to 21/22.

The tradeoff is a smaller redraw region rather than more complete historical correction: changed lines above the selected tail remain unprinted. The margin may help scrolling, but it does not reduce full-answer rendering work.

findings.description: The previously recorded reasoning-boundary answer loss remains unchanged.
findings.trigger: Rich reasoning mode receives a chunk containing the closing reasoning tag followed by answer text.
findings.expected_behavior: The answer suffix enters the Markdown answer and saved conversation response.
findings.actual_behavior: Streamer_rich.stream adds the whole chunk to think_text and calls begin without transferring the answer suffix into all_text. chat.main subsequently saves all_text.strip().

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree .stream( search located the direct chat.main call. Inspection of its streamer selection and response storage, alongside the complete task diff, establishes that this branch is carried over.
verification.limits: Reach is the inspected Rich reasoning workflow with the specified chunk boundary; dynamic or external callers and runtime reproduction were not established.

annotation.summary: Uses terminal rows minus two as the Markdown redraw budget, attempting to protect scrollback without changing rendering or answer accumulation.
